story.title: Why Asha Foundation exists
story.imageAlt: Hands planting a small seedling in soil
paragraphs: Asha Foundation began in 2011 with a single counseling room and a simple belief: that everyone deserves a safe space to talk about their mental health, free of stigma or judgment.
Since then, we've grown into a full community of counselors, volunteers, and support groups dedicated to making mental health care accessible to everyone — regardless of background or circumstance.
Today, we run individual and family therapy, group counseling, a 24/7 crisis helpline, and community workshops that reach thousands of people every year.

missionVision.title: Our Mission
missionVision.description: To provide compassionate, accessible mental health care and build a community where healing is possible for everyone.

missionVision.title: Our Vision
missionVision.description: A world where mental health is treated with the same care, urgency, and openness as physical health.
